An entity that carries on an enterprise must keep records that record and explain all transactions and other acts the entity engages in that are relevant to a matter under this Act. The records must be kept in writing in the English language, or so as to be readily accessible and easily convertible into writing in the English language. An entity must retain the records for at least five years after the completion of the transactions or acts to which they relate.
